title: THE OVERSEER FIGHTS IN THREE PHASES
why: His yes to suggestion 24, Overseer phases. The Overseer was one long health bar and a cannon. Now it has three phases you can read. Above two thirds of its health it fights as before. At two thirds it stops for a moment (a shockwave ring, a shake of the camera, a line on screen) and then calls crawlers out of the ground around it, three at a time, again every twenty seconds while it knows where you are, never more than six of its own. At one third it stops again and begins a sweeping laser every ten seconds: it stands still, turns to your bearing and charges for a second while the red aim lane fills, then sweeps a wide red beam across about ninety degrees, which hurts anyone standing in it and is stopped by walls, so you outrun it along the sweep or put a wall in the way. When the sweep ends its core is exposed: it vents for four seconds, unable to move or shoot, and every round that hits it does half again as much damage. The big score for killing it is unchanged. In co-op the host runs all of it and player 2 sees the beam and the phase lines.
now: The Overseer now has three phases: it calls crawlers at two thirds health, then sweeps a laser, and its core is exposed when the laser ends.
